entries.title: Psalms 78:1
segments: <<Maschil of Asaph.>> Give ear, O my people, to my  law: Incline your ears to the words of my mouth.

entries.title: Psalms 78:2
segments: I will open my mouth in a parable; I will utter dark sayings of old,

entries.title: Psalms 78:3
segments: Which we have heard and known, And our fathers have told us.

entries.title: Psalms 78:4
segments: We will not hide them from their children, Telling to the generation to come the praises of Jehovah, And his strength, and his wondrous works that he hath done.

entries.title: Psalms 78:5
segments: For he established a testimony in Jacob, And appointed a law in Israel, Which he commanded our fathers, That they should make them known to their children;

entries.title: Psalms 78:6
segments: That the generation to come might know [them], even the children that should be born; Who should arise and tell [them] to their children,

entries.title: Psalms 78:7
segments: That they might set their hope in God, And not forget the works of God, But keep his commandments,

entries.title: Psalms 78:8
segments: And might not be as their fathers, A stubborn and rebellious generation, A generation  that set not their heart aright, And whose spirit was not stedfast with God.

entries.title: Psalms 78:9
segments: The children of Ephraim, being armed and carrying bows, Turned back in the day of battle.

entries.title: Psalms 78:10
segments: They kept not the covenant of God, And refused to walk in his law;

entries.title: Psalms 78:11
segments: And they forgat his doings, And his wondrous works that he had showed them.

entries.title: Psalms 78:12
segments: Marvellous things did he in the sight of their fathers, In the land of Egypt, in the field of Zoan.

entries.title: Psalms 78:13
segments: He clave the sea, and caused them to pass through; And he made the waters to stand as a heap.

entries.title: Psalms 78:14
segments: In the day-time also he led them with a cloud, And all the night with a light of fire.

entries.title: Psalms 78:15
segments: He clave rocks in the wilderness, And gave them drink abundantly as out of the depths.

entries.title: Psalms 78:16
segments: He brought streams also out of the rock, And caused waters to run down like rivers.

entries.title: Psalms 78:17
segments: Yet went they on still to sin against him, To rebel against the Most High in the  desert.

entries.title: Psalms 78:18
segments: And they tempted God in their heart By asking food  according to their desire.

entries.title: Psalms 78:19
segments: Yea, they spake against God; They said, Can God prepare a table in the wilderness?

entries.title: Psalms 78:20
segments: Behold, he smote the rock, so that waters gushed out, And streams overflowed; Can he give bread also? Will he provide flesh for his people?

entries.title: Psalms 78:21
segments: Therefore Jehovah heard, and was wroth; And a fire was kindled against Jacob, And anger also went up against Israel;

entries.title: Psalms 78:22
segments: Because they believed not in God, And trusted not in his salvation.

entries.title: Psalms 78:23
segments: Yet he commanded the skies above, And opened the doors of heaven;

entries.title: Psalms 78:24
segments: And he rained down manna upon them to eat, And gave them  food from heaven.

entries.title: Psalms 78:25
segments: Man did eat the bread of the mighty: He sent them food to the full.

entries.title: Psalms 78:26
segments: He  caused the east wind to blow in the heavens; And by his power he guided the south wind.

entries.title: Psalms 78:27
segments: He rained flesh also upon them as the dust, And winged birds as the sand of the seas:

entries.title: Psalms 78:28
segments: And he let it fall in the midst of their camp, Round about their habitations.

entries.title: Psalms 78:29
segments: So they did eat, and were well filled; And he gave them their own desire.

entries.title: Psalms 78:30
segments: They were not estranged from that which they desired, Their food was yet in their mouths,

entries.title: Psalms 78:31
segments: When the anger of God went up against them, And slew of the fattest of them, And smote down the young men of Israel.

entries.title: Psalms 78:32
segments: For all this they sinned still, And believed not in his wondrous works.

entries.title: Psalms 78:33
segments: Therefore their days did he consume in vanity, And their years in terror.

entries.title: Psalms 78:34
segments: When he slew them, then they inquired after him; And they returned and sought God earnestly.

entries.title: Psalms 78:35
segments: And they remembered that God was their rock, And the Most High God their redeemer.

entries.title: Psalms 78:36
segments: But they flattered him with their mouth, And lied unto him with their tongue.

entries.title: Psalms 78:37
segments: For their heart was not  right with him, Neither were they faithful in his covenant.

entries.title: Psalms 78:38
segments: But he, being merciful, forgave [their] iniquity, and destroyed [them] not: Yea, many a time turned he his anger away, And did not stir up all his wrath.

entries.title: Psalms 78:39
segments: And he remembered that they were but flesh, A wind that passeth away, and cometh not again.

entries.title: Psalms 78:40
segments: How oft did they rebel against him in the wilderness, And grieve him in the desert!

entries.title: Psalms 78:41
segments: And they turned again and tempted God, And  provoked the Holy One of Israel.

entries.title: Psalms 78:42
segments: They remember not his hand, Nor the day when he redeemed them from the adversary;

entries.title: Psalms 78:43
segments: How he set his signs in Egypt, And his wonders in the field of Zoan,

entries.title: Psalms 78:44
segments: And turned their rivers into blood, And their streams, so that they could not drink.

entries.title: Psalms 78:45
segments: He sent among them swarms of flies, which devoured them; And frogs, which destroyed them.

entries.title: Psalms 78:46
segments: He gave also their increase unto the caterpillar, And their labor unto the locust.

entries.title: Psalms 78:47
segments: He  destroyed their vines with hail, And their sycomore-trees with  frost.

entries.title: Psalms 78:48
segments: He gave over their cattle also to the hail, And their flocks to hot thunderbolts.

entries.title: Psalms 78:49
segments: He cast upon them the fierceness of his anger, Wrath, and indignation, and trouble,  A band of angels of evil.

entries.title: Psalms 78:50
segments: He  made a path for his anger; He spared not their soul from death, But gave  their life over to the pestilence,

entries.title: Psalms 78:51
segments: And smote all the first-born in Egypt, The  chief of their strength in the tents of Ham.

entries.title: Psalms 78:52
segments: But he led forth his own people like sheep, And guided them in the wilderness like a flock.

entries.title: Psalms 78:53
segments: And he led them safely, so that they feared not; But the sea overwhelmed their enemies.

entries.title: Psalms 78:54
segments: And he brought them to the border of his sanctuary, To this  mountain, which his right hand had gotten.

entries.title: Psalms 78:55
segments: He drove out the nations also before them, And allotted them for an inheritance by line, And made the tribes of Israel to dwell in their tents.

entries.title: Psalms 78:56
segments: Yet they tempted and rebelled against the Most High God, And kept not his testimonies;

entries.title: Psalms 78:57
segments: But turned back, and dealt treacherously like their fathers: They were turned aside like a deceitful bow.

entries.title: Psalms 78:58
segments: For they provoked him to anger with their high places, And moved him to jealousy with their graven images.

entries.title: Psalms 78:59
segments: When God heard [this], he was wroth, And greatly abhorred Israel;

entries.title: Psalms 78:60
segments: So that he forsook the tabernacle of Shiloh, The tent which he placed among men;

entries.title: Psalms 78:61
segments: And delivered his strength into captivity, And his glory into the adversary's hand.

entries.title: Psalms 78:62
segments: He gave his people over also unto the sword, And was wroth with his inheritance.

entries.title: Psalms 78:63
segments: Fire devoured their young men; And their virgins had no marriage-song.

entries.title: Psalms 78:64
segments: Their priests fell by the sword; And their widows made no lamentation.

entries.title: Psalms 78:65
segments: Then the Lord awaked as one out of sleep, Like a mighty man that shouteth by reason of wine.

entries.title: Psalms 78:66
segments: And he smote his adversaries backward: He put them to a perpetual reproach.

entries.title: Psalms 78:67
segments: Moreover he refused the tent of Joseph, And chose not the tribe of Ephraim,

entries.title: Psalms 78:68
segments: But chose the tribe of Judah, The mount Zion which he loved.

entries.title: Psalms 78:69
segments: And he built his sanctuary like the heights, Like the earth which he hath established for ever.

entries.title: Psalms 78:70
segments: He chose David also his servant, And took him from the sheepfolds:

entries.title: Psalms 78:71
segments: From following the ewes that have their young he brought him, To be the shepherd of Jacob his people, and Israel his inheritance.

entries.title: Psalms 78:72
segments: So he was their shepherd according to the integrity of his heart, And guided them by the skilfulness of his hands.
